title: Pamalakaya slams demolition of Bacoor fishermen's floating houses

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines—The fishermen’s group Pambansang Lakas ng Kilusang Mamamalakaya ng Pilipinas (Pamalakaya) on Monday condemned the recent demolition the of more than 100 floating houses along the coast of Bacoor City, Cavite, saying the clearing would displace fishing families to make way for reclamation projects in Manila Bay. In a statement, Pamalakaya said the Bacoor local government demolished the structures from Oct. 27 to 29. The group said affected residents believed the clearing was intended to pave the way for a 420-hectare reclamation project involving the city government and Frabelle Fishing Corp.
